nodes.label: Mobile UI Redesign E2E Test Plan (Maestro)
nodes.rationale: Review artifact for a TDD loop: defines flows F1-F16, a style spec, and a testID contract for the dark-themed mobile IM redesign before any implementation code is written; all flows expected red until the app catches up. Resolves open questions: agent data model settled by issue #64 (gateway-spawned agents registered via POST /participants with kind/model, endpoint/protocol/capability concept dropped), and F11 client-side reply simulation removed in issue #79 because canned fake replies polluted real rooms.

nodes.label: testID Contract (README §3)
nodes.rationale: Maestro cannot read computed colors or font metrics from native views, so every style-bearing component must expose a stable kebab-case testID; the e2e suite asserts presence/position of these IDs as the structural proxy for style, with screenshots for human review and token-level Jest assertions deferred to implementation time.

nodes.label: Layered Style Coverage Strategy (README §2.3)
nodes.rationale: Style is verified in three layers because Maestro cannot inspect computed style: (1) automated structural testID assertions in flows/90-style.yaml, (2) human screenshot review against the prototype each iteration, (3) exact token values pinned later by Jest component tests importing a shared theme.ts.

nodes.label: agent-backend Tag (live gateway exclusion)
nodes.rationale: Flows needing a live maestro-gateway with real model credentials carry the agent-backend tag and are excluded from CI (--exclude-tags agent-backend); the older simulation tag was removed in issue #79 together with the client-side reply simulator.
